title: [2.7.2-dev] Graph shows temporary target of 0 for a few minutes
symptom: While an eating soon temporary target of 80 was set, the graph showed a temporary target of 0 for a few minutes. The user could not find anything in the logs.
cause: The cause is stated by a developer as wrong NS synchronization.
fix: The developer suggests turning on NS upload only, but the user reports that they already had it on at the time.
evidence_quote: this is caused by worng NS synchronization. turn on NS upload only
